text: {"lessons":["A purchase price is not a reason to keep holding; I should judge each position by its prospects, not by whether selling would admit a mistake.","A few months of price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term losses as if they were a trend.","I made no trades during these periods, but I should still review my holdings periodically and make deliberate decisions rather than defaulting to inaction."]}
